claims.evidence_quote: We demonstrate that the 3-hydroxy-3-methyl-glutaryl-coenzyme A (HMG-CoA) reductase inhibitors atorvastatin and simvastatin enhance functional outcome and induce brain plasticity when administered after stroke to rats.
claims.title: Statins induce angiogenesis, neurogenesis, and synaptogenesis after stroke.

claims.evidence_quote: Atorvastatin significantly increased the numbers of newly generated neuroblasts and promoted PS1 and NICD expression in the ipsilateral and homologous contralateral SVZ compared with saline-treated control rats.

notes.bbb_note: The label does not explicitly state whether atorvastatin crosses the blood-brain barrier or acts on the central nervous system, though it notes rare reports of cognitive impairment (memory loss, forgetfulness, confusion) associated with all statins.
notes.safety_note: The label does not contain a boxed (black box) warning; the main safety warnings include the risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis, immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy, hepatic dysfunction, and increased risk of hemorrhagic stroke in patients taking atorvastatin 80 mg with a history of recent hemorrhagic stroke.
